name: VPS Lakeshore Hospital
summary: VPS Lakeshore Hospital is a 470-bed multispeciality hospital in Kochi that opened in January 2003. It is NABH accredited and runs an Ayurveda wing, Ayurkshethra, alongside its modern departments.
highlights: Cardiac sciences with heart transplantation, and liver and kidney transplant programmes
Neurosurgery, orthopaedics with joint replacement, and a stroke management service
